name: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Execution
description: Detects Visual Studio Code tunnel execution. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate use of Visual Studio Code tunnel
query: ((NOT _exists_:process.pe.original_file_name) AND process.command_line:*.exe\ tunnel) OR (process.command_line:*.exe\ tunnel* AND process.command_line:*\-\-name\ * AND process.command_line:*\-\-accept\-server\-license\-terms*) OR (process.parent.command_line:*\ tunnel AND process.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND (process.command_line:*\/d\ \/c\ * AND process.command_line:*\\servers\\Stable\-* AND process.command_line:*code\-server.cmd*))
